title: A twisted double donor in donor–acceptor–donor D2–D1–A–D1–D2 type emitters yields multicomponent charge-transfer emission
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,18559-18565
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02848E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Dovydas Blazevicius, Gintare Krucaite, Alla Bogoslovska, Saulius Grigalevicius, Amjad Ali, Hans Ågren, Glib Baryshnikov, Oleg Dimitriev
Increasing twisting disorder in D2–D1–A–D1–D2 structure yields a transition from a dual to a triple emission band with an additional CT emission component, providing a corresponding red shift and increasing low-energy emission contribution.
